title: Erdos 662: corrected global threshold conjecture
summary: Disproves an explicitly corrected global threshold formulation of Erdos problem 662. For each radius, the conjecture bounds the average number of nearby points in every sufficiently large one-separated planar set by the unit triangular lattice's neighbor count. An exact rational oblique lattice and separated finite replicas violate the bound at radius six.

review.reason: Disproves a corrected global threshold conjecture for Erdős problem 662 using a explicit lattice construction.
